resolution.note: guest MemTotal tolerance max(256 MiB, 4%); redeploy follows

title: Scale the guest MemTotal tolerance with gate VM memory
body:
Outcome: the executor accepts the guest MemTotal of a large gate VM. execute.go:218 requires MemTotal within vm_memory_mib±256 MiB; at 12288 MiB the guest reports 11966 (kernel/firmware overhead 322 MiB, 245 at 8192), so every gate failed at setup with 'VM memory/headroom unavailable' after the 2026-11-05 deploy (Jenkins ci/product/main #88, PR-237 #1; .krn/runs/lead/ci-deploy/build88-diagnosis.md) and production was rolled back. The lower tolerance scales with VM memory (max(256, 4%)) and the refusal names the observed and expected values.
Proof: a Go receiver accepts MemTotal 11966 for a 12288 MiB profile, still refuses 11000 and 12600, wired into test/ci/executor-profile-bounds.test.ts (red at base by assertion).
